links.plain: reflex center and highway at the top of the spine
links.function: carries voluntary movement commands from the cortex down to the spinal cord; blocked by S3's 1996 stroke
links.narration_bridge: Explains why Cathy Hutchinson's mind stayed 100% sharp while signals could not reach her arms.

links.function: generates directional 3D reach-and-grasp firing patterns when S3 imagines moving her own arm, even 15 years after paralysis
links.narration_bridge: Houses the 4-millimeter 96-channel BrainGate sensor that persisted for 1,975 days (5 years).

links.function: maps the 3D tabletop location of the coffee bottle relative to the robotic hand and sends reach goals forward to motor cortex
links.narration_bridge: Guides continuous 3D trajectory corrections so the robotic hand grasps the bottle without knocking it over.

links.function: provides real-time visual feedback of robotic finger aperture and bottle position in the absence of robotic touch sensors
links.narration_bridge: Closes the visual-motor loop while S3 steers the straw smoothly upward.
